mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks (requester_id, provider_id, category, title, description, campus, location, delivery_location, deadline, reward_type, reward_description, reward_amount, completion_standard, requires_proof, only_in_app_contact, allow_offline_contact, is_instant_task, route_hint, risk_disclosure_confirmed, sensitive_reason, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{requesterId}, #{providerId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{description}, #{campus}, #{location}, #{deliveryLocation}, #{deadline}, #{rewardType}, #{rewardDescription}, #{rewardAmount}, #{completionStandard}, #{requiresProof}, #{onlyInAppContact}, #{allowOfflineContact}, #{isInstantTask}, #{routeHint}, #{riskDisclosureConfirmed}, #{sensitiveReason}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, req.nickname AS requester_name, prov.nickname AS provider_name FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN user_profiles req ON req.user_id = t.requester_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles prov ON prov.user_id = t.provider_id WHERE t.id = #{id}

SELECT t.*, (SELECT nickname FROM user_profiles WHERE user_id = t.requester_id) AS requester_name, (SELECT nickname FROM user_profiles WHERE user_id = t.provider_id) AS provider_name FROM tasks t WHERE t.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.*, req.nickname AS requester_name, prov.nickname AS provider_name FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN user_profiles req ON req.user_id = t.requester_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles prov ON prov.user_id = t.provider_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET requester_id = #{requesterId}, provider_id = #{providerId}, category = #{category}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, campus = #{campus}, location = #{location}, delivery_location = #{deliveryLocation}, deadline = #{deadline}, reward_type = #{rewardType}, reward_description = #{rewardDescription}, reward_amount = #{rewardAmount}, completion_standard = #{completionStandard}, requires_proof = #{requiresProof}, only_in_app_contact = #{onlyInAppContact}, allow_offline_contact = #{allowOfflineContact}, is_instant_task = #{isInstantTask}, route_hint = #{routeHint}, risk_disclosure_confirmed = #{riskDisclosureConfirmed}, sensitive_reason = #{sensitiveReason}, status = #{status}, created_at = #{createdAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, req.nickname AS requester_name FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN user_profiles req ON req.user_id = t.requester_id WHERE t.status = 'OPEN' AND t.deadline > NOW() ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
